newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA sees yields staying under pressure.
newsitem.headline: SIA sees yields staying under pressure.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said on Friday it expected yields to stay under pressure in the future.
The carrier said in a statement the outlook for passenger revenue remained cautious.

"Load factors are expected to be steady, with good support coming from business travel. However, with the firm Singapore dollar and unabated competition in the market, yields will stay under pressure," the statement said.

"The demand for cargo space picked up in recent months. Stronger demand can be expected for the year with the forecast recovery of the global electronics industry. Consequently, cargo yields are expected to improve."
